body:
## Context

Release-audit BLOCKER (install/first-run; release-blockers.md, plugin:adlc-opencode), verified by execution: in an empty directory with no .adlc, tool call 30 and everything after it is denied, and the plugin CREATES .adlc/.deny-store + .adlc/handoffs/denies/<session>.json in a repo that never opted into ADLC. The deny is repo-wide and cross-session, and the marker is written with ticket_id:null so `adlc handoff repair/resume` refuses it.

Root causes on HEAD 867b93c: (1) checkHandoff (plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/handoff-gate.mjs:129-175) has no .adlc guard — first statement is handoffAppliesTo (:139) — while both sibling enforcing adapters guard (codex adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:1073, claude-code adlc-hook.mjs:2217, the house pattern in 8 other CC modes). (2) The evaluate({...}) call at :153-163 omits ticketId, so the shared adapter defaults it to null (packages/context-handoff/lib/adapter.mjs:419) and ensureDenyMarker writes ticket_id:null. pi already threads it (extension.mjs:346); OpenCode is the only enforcing adapter that does not. (3) There are TWO call sites: index.mjs:186 (tool.execute.before) AND index.mjs:259 (permission.ask) — both unguarded, both must pass ticketId. (4) Deny text (:170-173) has no recovery diagnostic tail; codex builds one from trusted-local code (formatRecoveryCommand at adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:321, appended at :1256-1259).

Containment-only scope (Chris, 2026-08-22): depth epoch-reset on compaction, recovery-exception wiring, and key-free recovery are separate follow-up tickets. Note: the shared adapter hardcodes contentHash:null for EVERY host (adapter.mjs:477) — also a separate follow-up; do not fix it here.

## What to change

1. `lib/handoff-gate.mjs` — before any evaluation, return `{ decision: 'allow' }` when `.adlc` does not exist under root (existsSync(join(root, '.adlc')); add node:fs import).
2. `lib/handoff-gate.mjs` + `index.mjs` — accept ticketId in checkHandoff's input and pass it into evaluate({...}); both call sites (index.mjs:186 and :259) supply it from resolveRailsInForce(root, env).force.ticketId (already computed at :273/:284 — reuse, do not re-derive).
3. `lib/handoff-gate.mjs` deny text — append a trusted-local recovery diagnostic tail naming the session id and the host-side `adlc handoff` recovery command, porting the codex formatRecoveryCommand pattern (do NOT import it from the project-resolved package; build from local code, per the codex round-5 reasoning).
4. Tests (plugins/adlc-opencode/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs) — all additive: (a) non-ADLC dir: 40+ tool calls never deny and no .adlc/ is created; (b) in an ADLC repo with an active ticket, the deny marker's ticket_id equals the active ticket id; (c) deny message contains the recovery tail. Existing fixtures pre-create .adlc/ so nothing breaks.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Non-ADLC directory is inert: no deny, no .adlc/ created after 40+ calls. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs` exits 0 with the new containment test present.
2. Deny marker carries the active ticket id (non-null) when a ticket is active. verify: same test file asserts JSON.parse(marker).ticket_id === activeId; `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs` exits 0.
3. Deny message names the session id and an `adlc handoff` recovery command. verify: same suite asserts the substring; exits 0.
4. Whole plugin suite green. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: opencode: handoff gate fires only in ADLC repos and writes a resumable deny (ticketId threaded, recovery tail in deny text)
